findings.rootCause: The proposed binary sanitizer copies every ordinary JAR/POM and the verifier counts unclassified ordinary JARs as valid binaries. Owner allow/deny matching also uses raw startswith, so an owner such as cpf-common-private is treated as cpf-common.
findings.impact: Default-deny can be bypassed by an unclassified binary or a sibling owner prefix.

findings.rootCause: The proposed command runner prints and persists every raw argument, including the authenticated remote URL passed to git clone.
findings.impact: Embedded Git credentials can be disclosed to console and cpf-release logs.

findings.rootCause: The proposed Open Git artifact contract requires non-published cpf-admin/cpf-gateway Maven coordinates and rejects cpf-core publishSources=true even though the existing canonical public publication must first produce its documented source artifacts and the Open Git sanitizer then removes them.
findings.impact: The production release stops at stage 3 before testing the actual current Workspace publication/projection path.

next: Merge only the new paths, fix these root causes with fail-closed regression tests, then execute the current Workspace projection and release-tool test suite.
